body:
JSON on purpose. The loader accepts `.md`, `.mdx`, and `.json` so a pack can mix formats. *The Mollusk* is the nautical Ween record; in a real pack it would branch toward *White Pepper* and *Quebec*.

This stub exists so copying `content/ween` is enough to prove the app is generic.
